text:
maria: FYI - BlueRiver Foods requested a 6-week on-prem POC in a food-processing plant. Requirements: fully air-gapped (no network egress), physical media only, Thales Luna SA 7.5 HSM, FIPS required for signing and TLS, signed SBOM & provenance, quarterly patch windows. They want feasibility, offline activation flow, chain-of-custody for bundles, and a POC quote (license + on-site eng + courier). Can we scope?
sam: Clarifying q: will they provide the Luna appliances and keys (preferred), or expect Redwood to sign and ship? Also, confirm if operator workstations inside the perimeter are available.
maria: They will provide Luna appliances and keep keys in their custody. Operator workstation is available inside the plant for signing tasks, but no outbound network from that workstation. Kernel modules are locked down; no extra kernel-level drivers allowed.
leo: Runtime note: PKCS#11 userland integration is our path. We can load the Thales PKCS#11 module as an allowed library and use the Luna for detached signatures. No kernel modules required.
tara: Security checklist for the questionnaire: telemetry must be disabled by default and we must provide an attestation that no telemetry left nodes. We can produce signed SBOMs and provenance metadata. For FIPS: we do have a FIPS-compliant build pipeline for crypto stacks; need to confirm which components they require FIPS for (signing only, TLS, or entire runtime). Also confirm whether model encryption key unwrap must be HSM-backed.
sec-bot: Created ticket RDW-8341: "BlueRiver sealed-plant POC (Luna signing + courier flow)" assigned to @leo. https://redwood.example/tickets/RDW-8341
sam: Two viable signing flows:
1) Customer-sign (recommended): build farm produces manifest+sig-request; operator inside air-gapped zone uses Luna to sign; installer verifies via PKCS#11.
2) Redwood-sign then customer verifies: we sign and they validate with our public key (less control for customer).
leo: Sketch of offline signing flow and commands (concept):
```
# on CI: create bundle + manifest
rdwctl bundle create --model quant-rdw-7b --out rdw-bundle.tar.gz --manifest manifest.json
# create detached sig request for operator
rdwctl sig-request --manifest manifest.json > sigreq.bin
# operator inside airgapped zone signs with Luna appliance
pkcs11-tool --module /opt/thales/lib/pkcs11.so -s -y privkey -i sigreq.bin -o sig.bin
# installer verifies using the PKCS#11 module
rdwctl verify --manifest manifest.json --sig sig.bin --pkcs11 /opt/thales/lib/pkcs11.so
```
maria: They also want chain-of-custody: courier signs receipt with timestamp and we include a seal_id in manifest. Operator will check seal id + courier signature before applying. Add chain-of-custody steps to SOW.
tara: Patch cadence: we can package quarterly cumulative bundles for Private installs. For POC we will allow a one-off emergency hotfix delivered via courier with pre-approved acceptance procedure; manual apply time target <45m. Hotfixes must be pre-signed by customer Luna or go through an out-of-band approval process.
sam: Logistics note: without network egress we cannot do license phone-home. Offline license options:
- Time-limited activation token signed by customer's Luna (preferred).
- Offline license file signed by Redwood and countersigned by customer operator.
Both require physical renewal via media.
leo: Size guidance: incremental delta depends on quantization; expect 150MB-2GB typical for deltas, full bundles up to 10-20GB if non-quantized. Recommend quantized artifacts for courier efficiency.
sec-bot: Added labels to RDW-8341: "airgap", "luna", "fips", "chain-of-custody"
maria: Pricing sketch: Private deployment license + on-site eng days (2-5 days depending on integration), courier & handling per shipment, optional FIPS validation support (eng days + compliance review). Ben (finance) - please supply POC day rate & courier adders.
leo: Action items from eng:
- I will build a lab test with a Luna appliance and validate PKCS#11 signing/verify flow with our installer.
- Produce a sample manifest + sig-request and an installer image that verifies PKCS#11 signatures.
- Document the offline activation and renewal operator steps.
tara: I'll draft the SQ answers we control (telemetry, SBOM, encryption, incident contacts) and list the FIPS questions. Please DM me the customer questionnaire PDF.
maria: I'll schedule a 1hr presales + security + eng call with BlueRiver Wed 9am PT and circulate a draft SOW that includes chain-of-custody, courier pricing, on-site days, and POC acceptance criteria.
sam: Recommend we include acceptance criteria: model latency SLA to be validated in lab, offline upgrade apply target <1h for POC, zero outbound telemetry confirmed by attestation. Avoid hard latency numbers until perf run.
maria: Thanks team. I'll update the customer and attach the SOW draft to RDW-8341. :white_check_mark:
